title: Exporting for the Web
key_points: HTML5 export allows publishing games made in Godot Engine to the browser.
Projects written in C# using Godot 4 currently cannot be exported to the web.
Godot 4 can only target WebGL 2.0 (using the Compatibility rendering method).
The Web export requires support for `WebAssembly` and `WebGL 2.0` in the user's browser.
limitations: Several features work effortlessly on native platforms but are more complicated on the web platform.
Browsers restrict autoplay for audio on websites.
Low-level networking is not implemented due to lacking support in browsers.
Clipboard synchronization between engine and the operating system requires a browser supporting the `Clipboard API`.
asserts: HTML5 export allows publishing games made in Godot Engine to the browser, requiring support for WebAssembly and WebGL 2.0 in the user's browser.
scope: The scope of this document is HTML5 exporting functionality in Godot Engine, covering compatibility requirements and limitations.
